description: List the Helix workspaces the user belongs to. A workspace holds projects, and a project databases, Foundry's among them. A user with only one workspace may leave workspace_id empty everywhere; helix_create_workspace makes a new one.

page_size.description: Maximum results to return, from 1 through 100.

page_token.description: Opaque continuation token from the previous call.

name: helix_list_workspaces
title: List workspaces
